source: captured against the installed codex-cli 0.154.0 with a real codex TUI attached through tmux

topology.detached_backend: started with its own session id; its lifetime does not depend on any test/daemon pipe

shared_session.same_thread_ids: the thread id used by the control client equals the thread id the TUI resumed
observer_saw_ui_initiated: turn/completed for the same turn id
shared_session.ui_initiated_turn_source: turn/started arrived on the observer connection although the Theater-side control client never sent that turn

ui_readiness.method: deadline-bounded state polling of the tmux pane content
conditions: the composer placeholder 'Ask Codex to do anything' is visible
ui_readiness.no_blind_sleep: every wait is a predicate with a deadline; typed text is confirmed rendered before Enter is pressed

abrupt_control_client_death.action: both Theater-side connections closed without a WebSocket close frame
abrupt_control_client_death.reconnect: a fresh control client called thread/resume on the exact same thread id and succeeded
abrupt_control_client_death.ui_still_works: a turn typed into the TUI after reconnect completed and was observed by the reconnected control client

remote_flag.explicit_remote_works: with --remote the TUI attached to our backend: it rendered the exact thread history that exists only in that backend, and the observer connection saw the TUI's turns

bad_endpoint.outcome: the TUI process exits; the tmux session dies; the error goes to stderr
bad_endpoint.error_text: Error: Failed to resume session from <rollout path>: thread/resume failed during TUI bootstrap: thread/resume failed: no rollout found for thread id <thread-id> (code -32600)
bad_endpoint.no_silent_fallback: no embedded backend was started and our app-server stayed responsive and untouched
